meta.title: Technical SEO Consultant | Juan Carlos Angulo
meta.description: I am a software engineer and technical SEO consultant: audits, web performance and Next.js/Payload architecture to rank your site on Google.

hero.lede: I am a software engineer and technical SEO consultant. I go into the code, fix what holds Google back on your site and measure the result in Search Console.

medicion.title: Measurement before I touch the code
medicion.intro: Four readings tell me where a site hurts. The bar on each one shows the range Google rates good, needs improvement and poor.
medicion.note: The values in this strip are samples. They are not real measurements of any site.

gauges.name: LCP
gauges.what: How long the main element takes to paint

gauges.name: CLS
gauges.what: How much the layout shifts while loading

gauges.name: INP
gauges.what: How long the page takes to respond to a tap

gauges.name: TTFB
gauges.what: How long the server takes to send the first byte

tecnico.title: Technical SEO
tecnico.text: I audit crawling, indexation and structured data. I start with what Googlebot sees and decide from there what to touch.

dev.title: Next.js and Payload development
dev.text: I build with Next.js and Payload CMS and settle the SEO from the first commit: routes, metadata, sitemap and structured data.

rows.title: Infrastructure and servers
rows.text: I configure the server, headers and cache. When TTFB goes up, the problem is almost always on the server.

rows.title: Web performance
rows.text: I measure LCP, CLS and INP and go first after what weighs most: images, fonts and JavaScript.

rows.title: AI SEO and GEO
rows.text: I structure content so ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI answers can cite it.

audit.title: 360 Audit
audit.text: I review crawling, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, content and AI SEO in one report. You receive a plan ranked by impact, ready to apply, in 10 business days.

proceso.title: My process from audit to measurement

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: I review crawling, indexation, Core Web Vitals and structured data. I start from what Google sees today.

steps.title: Prioritize
steps.text: I rank findings by the impact they have on traffic, no matter how many warnings each tool raises.

steps.title: Fix
steps.text: I apply the change in the code or I leave the exact change for your team to apply.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: I compare Search Console and real Core Web Vitals before and after.

sobre.title: Software engineer who works on SEO
sobre.p1: I work on SEO from the code. I build with Next.js and a headless CMS like Payload, I settle SEO from the first commit and I audit before I build.
sobre.p2: I care about accessibility and mobile-first design. I work in Spanish and English.

items.a: I review crawling, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, content and AI SEO. I deliver a fix plan ranked by impact.

items.q: What do I receive and how long does it take?
items.a: You receive a report with the fix plan ranked by impact, and I deliver it in 10 business days. Write to me and I tell you how I adapt it to the size of your site.

items.q: Do you work with my development team?
items.a: Yes. I fix the code myself or I leave the exact change for your team to apply.

items.q: How do I measure the success of the optimizations?
items.a: I compare Search Console and real Core Web Vitals before and after. The figures in the cases come from there.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: I work in Spanish and English. I audit, write and build in both languages.
